rationale: diagnose_fix for job 20261102T224718Z-e79ead (process_failed: non-finite OmniQuant loss, layer 5 epoch 4 step 16), starting from the phi3_layer_down_let winner (same algorithm, DOWN_LET True). Root cause, replayed on the real model: under fp16 AMP the per-token-per-head V quantizer (and other dynamic activation quantizers) overflow in backward for near-constant rows (scale clamped at 1e-5, scale^2 underflows in fp16) whatever the loss scale; the GradScaler fell to 2.9e-39 and wrote NaN into the LET/LWC parameters. Fix: models/int_phi3_layer.py FP32ActQuantizer evaluates the dynamic activation and Q/K/V quantizers in fp32 and casts back (fp16 AMP and the method math unchanged); the adapter uses the same arithmetic (reload == in-memory 0.0). omniquant(): non-finite losses skip the step, an epoch with non-finite parameters or >50% non-finite losses rolls the layer back to its best epoch (keep_best_epoch). Real-model checks: layer 5 0 overflowed steps (was 44/88 per epoch), layers 2/4/13/29 stable, 6-layer real-model wrapper run clean (D15).
